Sometimes ChatGPT may fail to fetch your data.

1. Tap the GPT launch button in the YPT app and try again in a new chat.
2. Paste the copied text (Call the yeolpumta.com API with ...) as-is without editing.

app_guide3_content:
Allowed Apps are apps you can use while tracking your study time. (For example: dictionary apps, online lecture apps, etc.)

1. Tap the ⋮ icon located to the right of the start study button at the bottom of the home screen.
2. Select Allowed Apps from the menu.
3. Check the apps you need during your study session.
4. Tap the Allowed Apps tab while tracking your study time.
5. If you leave YPT during your study session, you’ll only be able to use the apps you registered as Allowed Apps. All other apps will be blocked.
app_guide4_content:
Create a group:
1. Go to the groups tab from the home screen.
2. Tap the + button to see the group list.
3. Tap the + button again to create a group.
Leave a group:
1. Go to the groups tab from the home screen.
2. Select the group you want to leave.
3. Go to settings and tap “Leave group.”
app_guide5_content:
1. Set your category to elementary, middle, or high school.
2. From the home screen, go to the Groups tab and tap [Enter school information].
3. After entering your school information, you can view your timetable, school meals, academic schedule, and more.

app_guide7_content:
Q: I’ve finished studying, but the break timer keeps running. How do I stop it?
A: No worries! The elapsed break time is only saved when you start a new study session. If you don’t start a new session, it won’t be logged.
(Breaks are only logged if the gap between study sessions is within 3 hours.)
Q: I don’t want to log break time at all.
A: You can disable break logging from the More tab → Settings button (top right).

challenge_wakeup_introduction_title: How many times did you hesitate to get out of bed today?
challenge_seat_introduction_title: How many times did you hesitate before finally sitting down at your desk today?
challenge_wakeup_introduction:
You know you have to get up, but haven’t you ever snoozed the alarm
or stayed in bed a little longer, only to watch your whole day fall apart?

But if you can overcome that moment just once a day, change will definitely begin.

Put your Flames on the line and check in with a photo each day to confirm you woke up before the set time. If you succeed, you’ll get a 100% refund of your entry fee and up to 30% in prize money.

Just one snapshot to start your morning.
Before you know it, your whole day will start to change.
challenge_seat_introduction:
You’ve probably had those moments when you know you should be studying, but start tidying your room for no reason,
or open YouTube with the excuse of taking a short break.

But if you manage to overcome that feeling even just once a day, that’s when real change begins.

Try checking in with a photo of yourself at your desk every day. If you complete the challenge, you’ll get a full refund of your entry fee, and you can even win up to a 30% bonus.

Just one photo a day to kick off your study routine at your desk.
You’ll find yourself getting focused before you even realize it.

challenge_cam_study_introduction:
Your chances of passing ultimately come down to one thing: your total study time.

Did you fully meet your study goal today? Sticking to your set hours every single day, without compromise—that’s the only real shortcut to success.

If you find it hard to trust your own willpower, stake some Flames on your goal and prove how much you want it. When you leave yourself no way out, you can hit your daily goals without making excuses.

From 1 to 12 hours, from 1 to 20 days. Take on a challenge that fits your goal and earn up to 40% guaranteed rewards for every successful hour.

Everyone knows that you need to put down your phone to sleep well, but it’s really hard to actually do it with willpower alone.

In the sleep challenge, you must not use your phone for 3 hours after tapping the start button to keep your Flames and succeed.

If building good sleep habits was tough on your own, try completing the challenge while protecting and growing your Flames for extra motivation.

Select your preferred sleep time freely between 10 PM and 2 AM, and earn up to 30% Flame rewards.

group_challenge_help_content1:
Create challenges unique to your group, such as waking up, sitting down to study, or attendance.

In real time, each member’s check-in icon for the day is displayed alongside their study time.
group_challenge_help_content2: When you create a challenge, it will appear in the group members' planners.
group_challenge_help_content2_1: In the classic version, it’s displayed under the subject.
group_challenge_help_content3: Members can tap the challenge shown in their planner to check in.
group_challenge_help_content4: View each member’s check-in status in real time.
group_challenge_help_content5: Members can set days off on specific dates and write the reason for their day off.
group_challenge_help_content6: If the check-in time passes, it will automatically be marked as failed, and you can provide a reason for the failure.
group_challenge_help_content7: There are two types of group challenges: “common challenge” and “custom challenge”.
group_challenge_help_content8:
The common challenge is a basic challenge provided by YPT, with set check-in rules and example photos that apply equally to all groups.

The start time is fixed at 5:00 AM, and you can select your own check-in deadline.
group_challenge_help_content9: For example, if the standard “Wake-up Challenge” is running in multiple groups, one check-in will count for all of them.
group_challenge_help_content10:
Custom challenges let your group freely create your own challenges. You can also set the check-in time as you wish.

You can add a description and example photo for the challenge you want to create, and check in by taking a photo with the camera or uploading a photo from your camera or album.

If you participate in both a group challenge and an official challenge, you can check in for both at once.
However, if the day is set as a day off, only the group challenge will apply, excluding the official challenge.

studicon_refund_short_desc: You can request a refund for unused Studicons within 7 days of purchase, except for Studicons used for group interactions or closing logs.
studicon_present_refund_short_desc: Refund is available for 7 days, only if the recipient hasn’t used the Studicon.
studicon_refund_long_desc:
Studicons are digital content as defined by Article 2, Paragraph 5 of the Framework Act on the Promotion of Cultural Industries. Because their value decreases significantly once they are applied, refunds are only available within 7 days of purchase if the Studicon has never been applied to any group.
To refund a purchased Studicon, go to Studicon Settings > Group Settings > select a Studicon. If eligible, the “Refund (Withdrawal of Purchase)” button will appear. Tap it to receive a refund in Flames.
To refund a gifted Studicon, go to Studicon Settings > Studicon Store > Gifts > Sent Gifts. If the recipient has not used the gift, the “Refund” button will appear within 7 days. Tap it to refund the Flames to the sender.

study_dialog_rest_desc:
• It refers to the time interval between one study session and the next.
• Any break lasting over 3 hours isn’t considered a break.
• By logging breaks, you can analyze the types of activities you engage in during your break time, which provides useful statistics.
• You can disable break logging in the settings. If you do, the statistics will categorize the time as 'other.'
• Only you can access and view the break logs.

token_help_token:
Tokens are the units used to interact with the AI for language processing.

Think of the term 'token' as synonymous with 'piece' or 'puzzle piece'. To help a computer process a sentence, such as “I went to the park”, we break it down into smaller components. This results in segments like “I”, “went”, “to”, “the”, and “park”. Each of these segments is referred to as a 'token'.
